name: Discourse
label: Discourse REST — topics, posts, users, search
description: Official Discourse REST at the forum origin (api_spec.json baseUrl defaults to https://try.discourse.org — replace with the customer forum origin). Handler: OfficialApiNode. Auth header Api-Key from secret api_key; extraHeaders send required Api-Username: {api_username}. Customer owns the forum and key. Never log api_key. Docs: https://docs.discourse.org/
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. topic_create needs title + raw (category optional numeric id). topic_get needs topic_id. post_create needs raw + topic_id. user_get needs username. search needs q. Do not put api_key here. Example: {"operation":"topic_get","topic_id":"123"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: topic_create | topic_get | post_create | user_get | search | trigger.

schema.label: forum_host
schema.description: Discourse forum hostname only (no scheme). Also config. Example: meta.discourse.org.

schema.label: raw
schema.description: Markdown body for topic_create / post_create. Official `raw`.

schema.label: category
schema.description: Numeric category id for topic_create (not a slug). Optional. Example: 4.

schema.label: topic_id
schema.description: Topic id for topic_get (GET /t/{topic_id}.json) and post_create. Example: '123'.

schema.label: q
schema.description: Search query for search (GET /search.json). Same operators as on-site search. Example: 'workflow after:2026-01-01'.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (forum JSON). trigger returns the BPMN message-event instruction — it does not open a socket. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON (topic, post, user, or search hits).

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: topic_create | topic_get | post_create | user_get | search | trigger.

configurationParameters.label: API key
configurationParameters.description: Discourse API key (StudioQuack secret). Sent as header Api-Key. Never log or place on INPUT. Admin → API → New API Key. Pair with config api_username (extraHeaders Api-Username).

configurationParameters.label: API username
configurationParameters.description: Discourse acting username sent as Api-Username (required with Api-Key). Example: 'system'.

configurationParameters.label: Forum Host
configurationParameters.description: Discourse forum hostname only (no scheme). Interpolated as https://{forum_host}. Example: meta.discourse.org.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 25. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.
